senses.gloss: בצל של ר׳ tuber of rikhpa, a kind of onion.
units: Tosef. ib. III, 14; Y. ib. V, end, 52ᵃ איזהו ב׳ של ר׳ כל שעוקצו וכ׳ what is the nature of a rikhpa onion? Its tail is squeezed into its inside; R. S. b. G. says, it has one shell only.—[Maim. to Maasr. l. c. suggests ר׳ to be a geographical term, corresp. to שום בעל בכי ib.]
